reddit.title: Improving Performance of Flowing Lakes in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant optimizations to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. Previously, drying a single cell would trigger a costly rescan of the entire map. Now, drying one cell only refreshes that specific area and its immediate neighbors, significantly reducing script time from 20 ms to 12 ms for a 64×64 lake. This means smoother gameplay with fewer interruptions. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Flowing Lakes Optimization in Provincia
steam.body: We've implemented optimizations for flowing lakes in Provincia, resulting in a significant reduction in processing time. Drying a cell now refreshes only the affected area and its neighbors, rather than rescanning the entire map. This change improves performance and enhances your gaming experience. Read more about it in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
